name: Book Entry
definition: Movement of cash between two accounts. One account is debited and the other account is credited.

TransferAdvice.name: Transfer Advice
TransferAdvice.definition: Indicates that when an amount of money has been transferred in the books of the account servicer, an advice should be sent back to the account owner.

CashEntry.name: Cash Entry
CashEntry.definition: Specifies the amount transferred on the account. An account entry may result in several cash entries for instance net amount (credited) and charges (debited).

DebitEntry.name: Debit Entry
DebitEntry.definition: Specifies the debit entry resuling from a settlement instruction.

CreditEntry.name: Credit Entry
CreditEntry.definition: Specifies the credit entry resuling from a settlement instruction.

FundSubscriptionCashInFlow.name: Fund Subscription Cash In Flow
FundSubscriptionCashInFlow.definition: Amount of money received from investors as a result of a subscription.

FundRedemptionCashOutFlow.name: Fund Redemption Cash Out Flow
FundRedemptionCashOutFlow.definition: Amount of money paid to investors as a result of a redemption.

RelatedSettlementInstruction.name: Related Settlement Instruction
RelatedSettlementInstruction.definition: Related settlement instruction wich is the source of the book entry.
